mapper.select: SELECT id, code, name, is_active AS isActive FROM project_type WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, code, name, is_active AS isActive FROM project_type WHERE code = #{code} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, code, name, is_active AS isActive FROM project_type ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT id, code, name, is_active AS isActive FROM project_type WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_type (code, name, is_active, type_name, type_desc) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{isActive}, #{code}, #{name})
